name: suspension shoulder external rotation
description: External rotation using straps. It strengthens the rotator cuff.
instructions: Hold the suspension handles and lean back with your arms in front of you and elbows lifted near shoulder height.
Bend your elbows about 90 degrees and keep your upper arms relatively steady.
Rotate your forearms upward and outward while drawing the handles toward the sides of your face.
Return slowly without letting your shoulders shrug. Adjust your body angle to control the load.
